_comment: A film preset. convert.cube renders Apple Log straight through a stock baked from spektrafilm
(luts/film/CHANGELOG.txt); the stock's curve is the only tone curve. Each clip's exposure
and white balance are metered in linear before the cube
(scripts/solve-exposure.py) against match.reference_stops; correct.* still adds on top.
Portra 800: the calibrated Portra 160 look at a higher speed (softer, lifted black, less
chroma; luts/film/CHANGELOG.txt), not a separate fit. The fastest Portra, so the grain is
coarse: 12, judged at delivery size, where 8 vanished in the encode. Stills stocks carry an
anti-halation layer, so the glow is slight.
name: Portra 800
